name: General sales tax return
legal_reference: Article 16 of the General Sales Tax Law No. 6 of 1994 as amended — a registered person subject to the general tax files a two-month return, the two months being one tax period, and the Director sets where the periods begin and end (the pack anchors them on January, March, May and so on, which the format requires and the text does not say); the Director may extend a period to six months at most; a person subject to the special tax files a month return, which the pack does not model. The return is the ISTD form CED:PR15.F12. The pack carries the lines a document writes into (2, 3, 5 to 10) and the totals of lines 14 and 15; the carry-forward, the adjustments and the refund claims (lines 1, 11, 12, 13, 16 to 19) are the preparer's.

boxes.name: Line 6 — Domestic sales taxed at 16 % — value
boxes.legal_reference: GST return (form CED:PR15.F12, "إقرار بالضريبة العامة على المبيعات", updated 7 November 2022), line 6, domestic sales taxed at 16 %: the value of the supplies, tax excluded.

boxes.name: Lines 14 and 15 — Tax payable (positive) or credit (negative)
boxes.legal_reference: GST return (form CED:PR15.F12, "إقرار بالضريبة العامة على المبيعات", updated 7 November 2022), line 14 — where the tax of lines 6 + 11 + 13 exceeds the tax of lines 1 + 2 + 3 + 12, the difference is payable; line 15 — where it is negative, the credit, which is refunded (lines 16 and 17) or carried forward (line 18). The two lines are one signed figure here: positive is payable, negative is the credit.
